module purpose: neorv32_package is a VHDL package that defines shared constants, record and array types, utility functions, and the component interface of neorv32_top. The package body only returns computed helper values from function arguments; it declares no package-level ports, signals, or stored state of its own.

use-case flows.value: helper return values for sizing, conditional selection, min/max selection, and boolean-to-std_ulogic conversion
helper return values for vector reductions, hexadecimal formatting, bit reversal, power-of-two testing, byte swapping, popcount, leading-zero count, and replication
helper return values for memory-image initialization, version-string formatting, and pattern matching
